Name: Adnah, Captain of Judah
Summary: Adnah was chief of the captains of thousands of Judah under Jehoshaphat, with three hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
KeyStory: Of Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the chief, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
